description: This file contains unit tests for the GstSrc class, specifically testing the initialization of the 'rialtosrc' element in GStreamer. It uses Google Test framework and mocks for GStreamer and GLib wrappers to verify behavior when the 'rialtosrc' element is present or absent.

classes.name: RialtoServerInitGstSrcTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing GstSrc initialization behavior related to the 'rialtosrc' element.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and creates an instance of GstSrc before each test.

methods.name: createGstSrc
methods.description: Sets up expectations for factory methods and creates the GstSrc object.
